lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's San Miguel County Housing Code working session — the sixth round of a Land Use Code rewrite aimed at making workforce and affordable housing easier to build, with zoning, density, and regulatory incentives all on the table and final recommendations taking shape. Tuesday's BOCC meeting runs a close second, with actual votes expected on two Land Use Code amendments covering Natural Medicine Businesses and Nonconforming Lots. HARC also holds public hearings Tuesday on the large-scale Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific, a multi-building project in an Accommodations 2 zone that's worth watching.

notable.stake: BOCC votes on Land Use Code changes for natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots.

HARC reviews alterations to Town Hall landmark and a floor-area-increasing addition to Parks office.
Public hearing on Ridgway lot resubdivision that could add a new buildable parcel on Hyde Street.
Rico board votes on water line replacement contract and historical society lease agreement.
County housing code rewrite advances — zoning, density, and affordable housing incentives being finalized.
